historical_evaluation: Existing 60 images have influenced development. Freezing now does not make earlier or later same-set evaluations independent held-out tests.
reporting_policy: Report observed results and failures as measured. A numeric target does not justify further tuning on this evaluation set.
publish_scope: Freeze metadata, reproduction instructions and root .env with the explicitly authorized temporary public demo key. No other private settings or credentials.
post_demo_credential_action: The project owner will revoke the shared API key at the provider after the presentation. Removing a file from GitHub does not revoke a credential.
